# This file highlights Sol-Ark-specific interface notes and the most critical MPG registers
# Interface: Modbus RTU RS485 on COM port (RJ45); 9600 baud 8N1; unit ID 1 (default)
# RS485 port: RJ45 connector on bottom of inverter; pin 7 = RS485-A+ pin 8 = RS485-B-
# Also accessible via Modbus TCP (disabled by default; enable in inverter Settings → Advanced)
# Sol-Ark 15K and 30K: use DB9/RS485 port labeled "BATT-COMM" or dedicated RS485 terminal block
# Protocol document: Sol-Ark Modbus protocol PDF (same content as Deye SUN-xK Modbus V118+)
# Function codes: FC03 (read holding) FC06 (write single) FC16 (write multiple)
